name: Blind
overview: Having received a tip on a rich house, Senya, who trades in small-scale criminal earnings, goes on a robbery. But he is caught by the owner, a very influential and eccentric businessman, Orlov, who also turns out to be blind. Suddenly, he doesn't turn him in to the police, but makes him his personal assistant. But the seemingly carefree life of a billionaire turns into a tough business struggle for Senya with a high-ranking official, where not only their own destinies, but also the lives of their loved ones are at stake.
